Adonijah exalted himself, saying, "I will be king." How does self-promotion show up in us?
Nathan and Bathsheba acted to see God's promise kept. How can you help see what's right is done?
Solomon rode on the king's mule and the people rejoiced. How does God keep his promises through succession?
David told Solomon, "Be strong... and keep the charge of the Lord your God." What charge do you want to pass on?
Solomon's kingdom was firmly established. How does God establish what he promises?
Solomon asked for an understanding mind to govern well. What would you ask God for?
God was pleased Solomon did not ask for riches or long life. What does this show about good prayer?
Solomon's wisdom brought justice for the true mother. How can God's wisdom help you in hard situations?
Judah and Israel ate, drank and were happy, each under his vine. What does this picture of peace stir in you?
God gave Solomon wisdom and breadth of mind. How is all wisdom a gift from God?
Solomon set out to build a house for the name of the Lord. What are you building for God?
Hiram rejoiced and blessed the Lord. How can others see God through our work?
God said, "I will dwell among the children of Israel." What does God's promise to dwell with us mean?
Solomon built with great care and costly materials. How can you give God your best?
Solomon spent thirteen years building his own house. How do you balance your own projects with God's work?
The temple furnishings were made with great skill. How can your skills serve God?
The glory of the Lord filled the temple. What does it mean for God to fill a place, or a life?
Solomon prayed, "Heaven cannot contain you; how much less this house." How do you approach the great God?
Solomon asked God to forgive those who turned back to him. What does this show about God's mercy?
"Not one word has failed of all his good promise." How has God been faithful to you?
God warned Solomon to walk in integrity of heart. What does integrity before God look like for you?
Solomon's kingdom grew in power and wealth. What are the dangers of success?
The queen of Sheba came to test Solomon and praised God. How can your life point people to God?
Solomon's wealth was great. What does the rest of his story show about the danger of riches?
Solomon's wives turned away his heart. What relationships pull your heart from God?
God was angry because Solomon's heart turned away. How can we guard our hearts?
God raised up Jeroboam because of Solomon's unfaithfulness. What does this show about God's sovereignty?
Rehoboam ignored wise advice and listened to his young friends. Whose advice do you listen to?
The kingdom divided, as God had said. What does this show about the cost of foolishness?
Jeroboam made golden calves so people wouldn't go to Jerusalem. How do people reshape worship for convenience?
The man of God obeyed and refused the king's invitation. How do you stay firm in obedience?
The man of God believed a lying prophet and disobeyed. How can you test what others say against God's word?
Ahijah gave a hard message to Jeroboam's wife. Why does God warn us?
Judah did what was evil, more than their fathers. What does this show about the slide into sin?
Abijam's heart was not wholly true to the Lord. What does a wholly true heart look like?
Asa did what was right and removed idols, even from his own family. What would wholehearted reform look like for you?
God warned Baasha through a prophet. How does God speak to us about our sin?
Ahab did more evil than all before him. What does this show about the pull of sin?
Ravens fed Elijah by the brook. How has God provided for you in unexpected ways?
The widow shared her last meal and her flour did not run out. What could you share in faith?
Elijah prayed and the boy lived. How has God answered your prayers?
Obadiah feared the Lord and hid the prophets. How can you serve God in a hostile setting?
Elijah asked, "How long will you go limping between two opinions?" Where are you undecided?
Elijah prayed simply and fire fell. What does this show about God answering prayer?
Elijah prayed and kept looking until a small cloud appeared. How do you keep praying when you see little?
Elijah was so afraid and tired he asked to die. When have you felt that way?
God gave Elijah food and rest. How does God care for us when we're worn out?
God was not in the wind, earthquake or fire, but in a low whisper. How do you listen for God's quiet voice?
God told Elijah there were seven thousand others faithful. How does knowing you are not alone help you?
God said, "I will give it into your hand today, and you shall know that I am the Lord." How does God show who he is?
God said he is God of the hills and the valleys. Where do you need to know God is with you?
Ahab sulked because he couldn't have Naboth's vineyard. What do you covet?
Jezebel plotted Naboth's death. How does God see injustice done to the powerless?
Ahab humbled himself and God showed mercy. What does this show about God's readiness to forgive?
Ahab hated Micaiah because he told the truth. Why do we prefer people who tell us what we want to hear?
Micaiah said, "What the Lord says to me, that I will speak." How can you speak truth faithfully?
Jehoshaphat walked in the ways of his father Asa. Whose faithful example do you follow?
